import mujoco

class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.n=25
  self.qref=self.d.qpos[7:26].copy(); self.feet=self.d.site_xpos[[1,2]].copy();self.feet[:,2]=0.008
  self.pelvis=np.array([0.015,0.,.98]);self.rot=np.eye(3);self.hands={};self.stance=[True,True]
  self.kp=self.m.actuator_gainprm[:,0];self.kv=-self.m.actuator_biasprm[:,2]
 def jac(self,body=None,site=None,data=None):
  d=self.d if data is None else data;jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  if site is not None:mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,d,jp,jr,site)
  else:mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,d,jp,jr,body)
  return np.vstack([jp[:,:25],jr[:,:25]])
 def action(self):
  d=self.d;m=self.m;n=25; eps=1e-5
  self.k.qpos[:]=d.qpos;self.k.qvel[:]=d.qvel
  mujoco.mj_integratePos(m,self.k.qpos,d.qvel,eps);mujoco.mj_fwdPosition(m,self.k)
  tasks=[];vals=[]
  def add(J,err,kp=80,kd=18,weight=1,Jnext=None):
   jd=np.zeros(len(err)) if Jnext is None else (Jnext-J)@d.qvel[:25]/eps
   tasks.append(J*weight);vals.append((kp*np.array(err)-kd*(J@d.qvel[:25])-jd)*weight)
  Jp=self.jac(body=1); Jpn=self.jac(body=1,data=self.k)
  R=d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3)
  e=.5*(np.cross(R[:,0],self.rot[:,0])+np.cross(R[:,1],self.rot[:,1])+np.cross(R[:,2],self.rot[:,2]))
  add(Jp[:3],self.pelvis-d.qpos[:3],70,18,3,Jpn[:3]); add(Jp[3:],e,120,22,4,Jpn[3:])
  Jfeet=[]
  for i in range(2):
   J=self.jac(site=i+1);Jn=self.jac(site=i+1,data=self.k)
   Rf=d.site_xmat[i+1].reshape(3,3)
   er=.5*sum((np.cross(Rf[:,j],np.eye(3)[:,j]) for j in range(3)))
   if self.stance[i]:
    add(J,np.r_[self.feet[i]-d.site_xpos[i+1],er],150,25,10,Jn);Jfeet.append(J)
   else:add(J,np.r_[self.feet[i]-d.site_xpos[i+1],er],150,25,4,Jn)
  Jq=np.zeros((19,25));Jq[:,6:]=np.eye(19);add(Jq,self.qref-d.qpos[7:26],30,8,.3)
  for site,target in self.hands.items():
   J=self.jac(site=site)[:3];Jn=self.jac(site=site,data=self.k)[:3]; add(J,target-d.site_xpos[site],100,20,5,Jn)
  A=np.concatenate(tasks);b=np.concatenate(vals)

  JT=np.concatenate([j.T for j in Jfeet],axis=1) if Jfeet else np.zeros((25,0));nf=JT.shape[1];N=25+nf

  C[len(b):len(b)+19,:25]=M[6:]*.012;C[len(b):len(b)+19,25:]=-JT[6:]*.012;rhs[len(b):len(b)+19]=-bias[6:]*.012
